controls.control: AI system scope, authority boundary, risks and accountable roles are versioned.
controls.verification: Run pnpm lint:ai-agent-enterprise-controls and review the risk register quarterly.
controls.failureAction: Block permission expansion and open an architecture decision before release.
controls.reviewCadence: Quarterly and before any new tool/provider/permission
controls.nextAction: Assign named organizational owners when the first employee or external operator is added.

controls.control: Unknown tools and policy failures deny by default; writes require scoped approval.
controls.verification: Unit and production synthetic approval recovery tests pass.
controls.failureAction: Disable AI_AGENT_HARNESS_V1 or roll back the Cloud Run revision.

controls.framework: NIST AI 600-1; OWASP improper output handling
controls.control: Output moderation failure replaces unverified output, emits durable evidence and a critical alert.
controls.verification: Inject moderation failure and assert raw output is neither persisted nor returned.
controls.failureAction: Roll back and keep the safe response path enabled.

controls.control: Every named Agentic Top 10 risk has frozen adversarial regression cases.
controls.verification: Semantic dataset validation requires at least five cases per risk and all negative controls reject.
controls.failureAction: Fail CI and do not publish the affected Agent configuration.
controls.reviewCadence: Every release and after every stable failure cluster

controls.framework: NIST AI RMF privacy-enhanced; data minimization
controls.control: Evaluation and production acceptance use synthetic data and persist only hashed or aggregate evidence.
controls.verification: Secret scan passes and sanitized reports contain no prompt, response, tool arguments or reviewer notes.
controls.failureAction: Delete the artifact, rotate exposed credentials and open a privacy incident.

controls.framework: NIST AI RMF Measure; OpenAI evaluation guidance
controls.control: Frozen typical, edge and adversarial corpus has deterministic hard gates and calibrated negative controls.
controls.verification: pnpm harness:semantic-eval passes the frozen version and reports 735/735 rejected negative controls.
controls.failureAction: Fail CI and investigate the dataset, grader or changed behavior.

controls.control: Deployed-model outputs are identity-blinded and independently reviewed before production quality claims.
controls.verification: A full production_agent submission reports independentReviewRate=1 and passes all gates.
controls.failureAction: Do not make a production-quality claim; keep failures as regression cases.
controls.reviewCadence: Before customer launch and after model/config changes
controls.nextAction: Capture the frozen v2 corpus from the deployed Agent and complete a separate blind review.

controls.control: AI availability, latency, error, safety and budget objectives have indicators, alerts and rollback actions.
controls.verification: Review the rolling 28-day scorecard and exercise one alert acknowledgement each release.
controls.failureAction: Stop releases on exhausted error budget; disable Harness or roll back when a hard safety SLI fails.
controls.nextAction: Collect 28 days of real traffic before converting provisional objectives into contractual SLOs.

controls.control: Backups and point-in-time recovery are verified by an isolated restore drill with measured RPO/RTO.
controls.verification: Authorized workflow run restores to an isolated target, validates data and deletes the target.
controls.failureAction: Block customer launch and repair backup/PITR configuration before retest.
controls.reviewCadence: Quarterly and after database topology changes
controls.nextAction: Run the destructive-capable restore workflow only after explicit target-specific authorization.

controls.control: Every external GitHub Action is pinned to an immutable commit SHA.
controls.verification: pnpm lint:dep-pins rejects any floating external Action reference.
controls.failureAction: Fail CI and pin the reviewed upstream commit.

controls.control: The production artifact has an SBOM; signed build provenance is verified before deployment.
controls.verification: Verify image digest, provenance signature, builder identity and expected source commit before Cloud Run deploy.
controls.failureAction: Do not deploy an unsigned or mismatched image.

controls.control: Runtime and deployment identities are separate and runtime has only required resource permissions.
controls.verification: Cloud Run describes a dedicated runtime service account and deployment preflight verifies it.
controls.failureAction: Block customer launch until runtime identity and IAM policy are corrected.
controls.nextAction: Create/approve a dedicated runtime service account and explicitly configure Cloud Run to use it.

controls.framework: NIST AI RMF Manage; Google Cloud reliability learning
controls.control: AI safety and reliability incidents have severity, containment, evidence, recovery and regression closure.
controls.verification: Run a tabletop exercise and verify alert acknowledgement, rollback and regression-case creation.
controls.failureAction: Keep the incident open until owner, timeline, root cause, corrective test and recurrence guard exist.
controls.reviewCadence: Twice yearly and after every SEV-1/SEV-2
controls.nextAction: Complete the first tabletop exercise before customer launch.
